cases.name: Ada Senenfelder
cases.narrative: On 6/6/1985, she was found deceased in her home and had been cut and stabbed 33 times.

cases.name: Madeline Jane "Maddie" Kingsbury
cases.narrative: On 6/7/2023, her remains were found by a sheriff’s deputy between Choice and Mabel, Minnesota, on a property maintained by one of Fravel’s family members. Her body was wrapped in a sheet and black Gorilla tape that matched items found in their home. A medical examiner noted that a knotted towel had been wrapped around Kingsbury's head and neck. She was partially encapsulated by a culvert, and appeared to have been covered by wooden debris. A preliminary autopsy report determined the manner and cause of death as homicide and homicidal violence.
